final: WITH counts_by_race AS (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) as race_count FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) as total FROM counts_by_race), ratios AS (SELECT cbr.raceId, cbr.race_count, CAST(cbr.race_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as ratio FROM counts_by_race cbr CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL AND tc.total > 0), avg_ratio_value AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.raceId, r.race_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - ar.avg_ratio as difference FROM ratios r CROSS JOIN avg_ratio_value ar WHERE ar.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
